messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Adderall is a central nervous system stimulant.
Adderall is used to treat attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).
Adderall is used to treat a sleep disorder called narcolepsy.
Adderall contains mixed amphetamine and dextroamphetamine salts.
Adderall contains a combination of amphetamine and dextroamphetamine.
These substances affect chemicals in the brain and nerves.
These chemicals contribute to hyperactivity and impulse control.
For ADHD, Adderall is used in children 3 to 17 years of age and in adults.
Adderall may help increase attention and decrease impulsiveness and hyperactivity.
For narcolepsy, Adderall is used in people 6 years and older.
It is not known if Adderall is safe and effective for ADHD in children under 3 years of age.
It is not known if Adderall is safe and effective for narcolepsy in children under 6 years of age.
Adderall is a federally controlled substance (CII).
Adderall contains amphetamine.
Amphetamine can be a target for people who abuse prescription medicines or street drugs.
Keep Adderall in a safe place to protect Adderall from theft.
Triples: [["Adderall", "has drug class", "central nervous system stimulant"], ["Adderall", "treats", "attention deficit hyperactivity disorder"], ["Adderall", "treats", "narcolepsy"], ["Adderall", "contains", "mixed amphetamine and dextroamphetamine salts"], ["Adderall", "contains", "combination of amphetamine and dextroamphetamine"], ["mixed amphetamine and dextroamphetamine salts", "affects", "chemicals in the brain and nerves"], ["chemicals in the brain and nerves", "contribute to", "hyperactivity and impulse control"], ["Adderall", "has recommended use in", "children 3 to 17 years of age"], ["Adderall", "has recommended use in", "adults"], ["Adderall", "may help increase", "attention"], ["Adderall", "may help decrease", "impulsiveness"], ["Adderall", "may help decrease", "hyperactivity"], ["Adderall", "has recommended use in", "people 6 years and older"], ["Adderall", "not known safe and effective in", "children under 3 years of age for ADHD"], ["Adderall", "not known safe and effective in", "children under 6 years of age for narcolepsy"], ["Adderall", "has controlled substance schedule", "CII"], ["Adderall", "contains", "amphetamine"], ["amphetamine", "can be targeted by", "people who abuse prescription medicines or street drugs"], ["Adderall", "has storage instruction", "keep in a safe place to protect from theft"]]
Relations: ["affects", "can be targeted by", "contains", "contribute to", "has controlled substance schedule", "has drug class", "has recommended use in", "has storage instruction", "may help decrease", "may help increase", "not known safe and effective in", "treats"]
Answer:

completion:
affects: The subject substance influences or alters the function of the object entity, which is typically a biological process or system.
can be targeted by: The subject substance is a potential object of misuse or abuse by the group specified by the object entity.
contains: The subject drug or substance includes or comprises the component or ingredient specified by the object entity.
contribute to: The subject entity plays a role in the development or occurrence of the object entity, typically a physiological process or condition.
has controlled substance schedule: The subject drug is classified under the controlled substance schedule specified by the object entity, indicating its regulatory status.
has drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
has recommended use in: The subject drug is recommended for use in the population or group specified by the object entity.
has storage instruction: The subject drug should be stored in the manner specified by the object entity to ensure safety and prevent misuse.
may help decrease: The subject drug may reduce or alleviate the symptom or condition specified by the object entity.
may help increase: The subject drug may enhance or improve the function or condition specified by the object entity.
not known safe and effective in: The subject drug has not been established as safe and effective for the population or condition specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
